name: Super Admin
summary: Full system access, including users, roles, settings and audit logs.
permissions: Change course rules and certificate numbering

name: Administrator
summary: Runs students, courses, enrolments, learning, results, certificates and reports.

name: Facilitator
summary: Teaches assigned courses and the learners enrolled in them.
permissions: View assigned courses and their learners

name: Student
summary: Sees only their own learning, results, attendance and certificates.
permissions: View own results, attendance and certificates
